issue.title: Harden API token injection (remove mutable singleton + fake async)

comments.body: **Attribution clarification:** The `_activeToken` singleton + fake-async `getHeaders` originate from the better-auth work (PR #46/#82); @mattrace-gloo's CNG change (PR #70) only relocated env handling + added error logging. The hardening in this ticket targets the **inherited** pattern, not the CNG work. Scope unchanged — this remains a legitimate harden task.
